video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Peyton Watson Media Availability | 10.02.2026

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the organizational similarities between the Cavaliers and Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: It reminds me of Denver, very serious off top, really emphasizing our habits and building those consistencies.
quotes.quote: Obviously I would say just the organization and how well-run it is. It reminds me of Denver, very serious off top, really emphasizing our habits and building those consistencies throughout the season. Off the court, there has been so much team building and camaraderie building exercises that we have done, and we have really been getting along. I think that goes a long way, and us liking each other off the court will continue to help our chemistry on.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says the Cavaliers organization reminds him of Denver in terms of how serious they are about building habits and consistency.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his defensive role and versatility for the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I want to be really versatile for this team and provide that punch and that young energy.
quotes.quote: I want to be really versatile for this team and provide that punch and that young energy that we need. First and foremost, speaking defensively, just being the anchor of our defense and really being someone who is loud and vocal on that end. Just helping guys out in any way that I can and making things easier on that end of the floor. Then also on offense, just my mind for the game. I have really learned how to read the game well playing on championship-contending teams since I have been in the league.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says he wants to be the anchor of the Cavaliers defense and provide a punch of young energy for the team this season.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his potential as an elite two-way player
quotes.excerpt: I think that I really have all the tools to affect the game on both sides.
quotes.quote: I think the upside is the greatest, just being an extremely elite two-way player. I think that I really have all the tools to affect the game on both sides of the floor. I have already shown flashes of being an elite defender and I am going to continue to put that together over a whole season and push myself to be an All-NBA defensive player. But at the same time, just my promise offensively, I have got a smooth shot, my handle is really good, and like I said, I have got a good mind for the game.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson has big goals for his time in Cleveland, stating he is pushing himself to become an All-NBA defensive player.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the defensive impact of playing with Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen
quotes.excerpt: It is amazing just knowing in the back of my head that I can play aggressively.
quotes.quote: It is amazing just knowing in the back of my head that I can play aggressively and super physically out front, knowing that I have those guys behind me. And then also those guys just emphasizing being more vocal on the floor this year is really going to help me out because it is going to allow me to just be up top and guard without having to be looking around or wondering what is going on behind me. I know those guys have it down pat.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says having Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen behind him allows him to play more aggressively and physically on the perimeter.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his defensive approach against elite offensive players
quotes.excerpt: I think just to make them uncomfortable as possible, to disrupt a little bit.
quotes.quote: I think just to make them uncomfortable as possible, to disrupt a little bit. I have these unique qualities that allow me to kind of be a defensive playmaker. One thing I have been working on since I got in the league was my discipline and being a solid defender. I think that I have always had the ability to make those plays up at the rim, block shots on the perimeter, play the passing lanes, get steals. Now I feel like I am going to be more empowered having that backline behind me.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson on his defensive mindset: I have unique qualities that allow me to be a defensive playmaker and I want to make opponents as uncomfortable as possible.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the mental toughness needed to compete for a championship
quotes.excerpt: It just takes a lot of mental toughness. I think it takes a lot of resilience.
quotes.quote: It just takes a lot of mental toughness. I think it takes a lot of resilience throughout the season, as we see the East is as strong as it has ever been. I think that is going to be a good test for us in the regular season for us to face some adversity and some challenges and learn more about ourselves. I think you learn the most about yourself when you are facing times of uncertainty and uncomfortability.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson believes the strength of the Eastern Conference will be a good test for the Cavaliers to face adversity and learn about themselves.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on taking the pressure off Donovan Mitchell and Darius Garland
quotes.excerpt: That is music to my ears when I hear that I am going to be able to.
quotes.quote: I think a lot of the pressure is on those guys. They are getting guarded and scouted for with the best of them. These guys have been elite players now for so long, that is music to my ears when I hear that I am going to be able to catch the ball in a position to kind of make some plays and make the game easier for them and for my other teammates as well. So I am extremely excited to be able to step into that role and provide that punch.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson is ready to step into a role that makes the game easier for Donovan Mitchell and Darius Garland by taking some of the pressure off them.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on what he learned playing alongside Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: It definitely taught me a lot about my positioning, how to cut, where to be.
quotes.quote: It definitely taught me a lot about my positioning, how to cut, where to be at the right place at the right time, and how to make his job easier. So I definitely learned a lot about what windows to be in and how to move off the ball to help those star guys out. It will be a little bit different obviously playing with a center and then playing with guards who more so have the ball, but I will be able to fit in wherever I can.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says playing with Nikola Jokic taught him a lot about positioning and how to move off the ball to help star players.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the trade rumors involving the Lakers and Clippers
quotes.excerpt: I was a restricted free agent and I think a lot of people misconstrue that.
quotes.quote: I mean, I think in general, the Lakers have a big social media following, the Clippers as well, and I am a kid from LA. So you know, I think that would be in their ideal world, the story that works for them. But the whole time it was out of my hands regardless. I was a restricted free agent and I think a lot of people misconstrue that. I think a lot of people think that I had the choice of where I wanted to go, and it was more so not in my hands. It was about the trade that Denver wanted to take or they wanted to retain me.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson clarifies his trade rumors: It was out of my hands. I was a restricted free agent and it was about the trade Denver wanted to take.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on why the Cavaliers can reach the top of the East
quotes.excerpt: I think it starts on the defensive end. I think that we have guys who can score.
quotes.quote: I think it starts on the defensive end. I think that we have guys who can score, we have dynamic players, we have guys who are perennial All-Stars and then we have guys who are capable of being All-Stars. So I think that offensively, that will always continue to get better and better as the season goes on, but I think us setting the tone defensively and really being a team that protects the paint and guards the three-point line well will definitely propel us to where we want to be.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson believes the Cavaliers path to the top of the East starts on the defensive end by protecting the paint and guarding the three point line.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the competitive landscape of the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: There are a lot of great, great teams in the East and a lot of great talent.
quotes.quote: It is really hard to say because you never know what the teams even look like coming into the end of the season. Like health plays a big part in how a lot of the seasons go. There are a lot of great, great teams in the East and a lot of great talent. You know, Miami has got Giannis, like I said, Philly has done a lot with their roster as well. Then obviously the Pacers are getting back healthy, they were in the championship two years ago, you can never count them out.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson on the Eastern Conference: There are a lot of great teams and talent, you can never count anyone out.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his focus on three-point shooting and physical development
quotes.excerpt: I think definitely just working on continuing to shoot the ball at an elite level.
quotes.quote: I think definitely just working on continuing to shoot the ball at an elite level. I have really raised my three-point acumen and I have gotten really, really good with that, and that has allowed me to be guarded in a way that opens up the strengths in my game. And what comes naturally to me, which is slashing, getting to the rim, finishing above the rim, and I think also getting stronger as well, just being able to take contact better and being able to be more durable throughout the season.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says he has raised his three point acumen to open up his game and is focused on getting stronger to be more durable this season.

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the team culture and personality of the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: We got some amazing guys on the team. Every individual presents their own unique personality.
quotes.quote: We got some amazing guys on the team. Every individual presents their own unique personality and that is what I love about the team, nobody is afraid to be themselves. And I think that that will really shine on the court as well because we got guys who are not afraid, we got guys who know what they are going out there to do and we have true professionals on the team. So I think that I fit in perfectly with that because that is what I have been doing for my whole career.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says he fits in perfectly with the Cavaliers because the team is full of true professionals who are not afraid to be themselves.
